about.text: A DOP sheep's cheese from the province of Vibo Valentia in Calabria, made from raw sheep's milk and kid or lamb rennet. It is sold fresh, semi-matured or matured for up to 24 months.

sources.text: Milk, process, ageing categories, area and DOP status from the Wikipedia article; rind and paste at ageing from the Fine Dining Lovers article.
